nom: Minimalist Glycolic Acid 08% Exfoliating Toner for Body, Face, Underarms & Scalp

avis.titre: Effective and Affordable—Just as Good as the Dermatologist’s Pricey Brand!
avis.texte: My dermatologist recommended a glycolic acid toner to help with some texture and deep pores on my cheeks—but their house brand would’ve cost me hundreds each month. I found this Minimalist version instead, and I’m so glad I did! I’ve been using it every morning as part of my makeup routine, and the results are impressive. My skin looks smoother, the bumps have faded, and when I use it consistently, I get an almost poreless look across my nose and cheeks. It’s made a huge difference in my skin’s appearance and confidence. That said—this toner is strong. It has a noticeable tingle or burn when first applied, especially if your skin is sensitive or dry. A little goes a long way. If you overdo it, you might experience irritation, so I recommend starting slow. And if your skin starts feeling raw or tight, take a break for a couple of days to let it reset. Overall, this is a powerful and budget-friendly alternative to high-end glycolic treatments. Just use it with care and your skin will thank you.

My daughter is living the product! She is using it on her rough dry heels which used to scratch against her sheets at night and resolved that issue in a week! Also using it on her dry darkened elbows with same good results!

avis.titre: Dull skin after first use! Love it!
avis.texte: I’m impressed! After my first use, I could see an improvement of my skin surface. No longer appeared dull. I followed the instructions which noted to use 1-2 times a week. This glycolic toner will replace so many ineffective products that I purchased. Great Value!
It is more calming than the ordinary one. Only use at night and 2-3 times a week, you will see the difference in your skin. Helps smooth the skin and clear the skin and brightening the skin.

If you have sensitive skin do not get this I used it once and now I’m fighting to get my face back to the way it was. I never had dark marks on my face before and it broke me out so bad. It’s all over my forehead, my nose, and my cheek cheeks

avis.titre: Definitely give this product a try!
avis.texte: Great!!! I am already seeing a change in how bright and soft my skin is after 2 weeks of use. Now its been about 2 months and my skin has changed so much! I cannot believe how amazing this product is! Highly recommend using it but do a spot test because my skin is pretty strong but my mom and grandma have more sensitive skin so it felt a little tingly when they put it on but they had no reaction or anything besides that.

I really liked this facial product. It feels gentle and refreshing on the skin, absorbs easily, and leaves my face feeling clean, soft, and hydrated. It’s easy to use and has become a nice addition to my skincare routine. I’m very happy with the results!

avis.titre: Flip top cap could be improved
avis.texte: I really like this toner for my hair. The only criticism I have for this product is that the top isn’t the easiest to use to apply to hair. I prefer other brands that have a nozzle tip instead of just a flip top cap. Nonetheless, I will purchase this product and just pour it into my preferred bottle and cap type since this is cheaper for essentially the same product.

I really love this Minimalist glycolic toner. The texture is light and refreshing, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t feel sticky. I use it not only on my face but also on areas like underarms and neck, and my skin feels smoother, softer, and looks healthier. No irritation so far, though I recommend starting slowly if you have sensitive skin
I like how this feels on my skin. Great value for the price. The Bottle is quite big.
really good would recommend make sure to wear sunblock after application did wonders for my skin

avis.titre: Basic must have for everyday use.
avis.texte: Gentle and effective for the prevention and cleansing of bacteria on skin, feet, underarms, scalp. An excellent product.

The only product that helped get rid of my keratosis pilaris on my arm, disappeared COMPLETELY!!! I am soooo impressed. It also lightened my pimple scars. I only use it 3x a week as quite strong. Waited 3 weeks before leaving a review as wanted to test it first. I love love love this product. So happy I bought it.
